# Project memory

> **Generated file — do not edit.** Every entry below is a memory in this project's `nxm` store, projected here so the context survives without nexus-flow installed. Change it with `nxm remember` / `nxm forget`; an edit made here is overwritten by the next write. `nxm doc --check` reports drift.

### `logo-font-vectorization`

Logos are vectorized from Merriweather Black (wght 900) at the DEFAULT/text optical size. Do NOT set the variable font's opsz axis to its max (144 = display) — that yields a high-contrast display cut that looks 'not Merriweather'. The @fontsource static 900 woff (default opsz) matches Google Fonts and is what the logos use. Generator: fontTools + SVGPathPen; the parent wordmark is 'nxsflow' with only the f in brand lime, outlined; favicon = n+f unmerged (logos/nexflow-parent/).

---

### `brand-skill-duplicate`

BRAND.md and plugin/skills/nxsflow-brand/SKILL.md are hand-maintained duplicates — there is NO generator (scripts/ only holds render-logos). Any change to the '## Messaging' section must be applied to both and verified byte-identical, e.g.: awk '/^## Messaging$/,/^## Colors$/' <file> on each, then diff. The plugin copy is the one actually read, because it loads into every assistant session. Content changes also bump plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json (minor for refinements, major for breaking) — that is the repo convention.

---

### `brand-repo-public-rules`

nxsflow/brand is a PUBLIC repo. Two standing rules: (1) Language rule from the GTM spec — no competitor name, no 'alternative to', no comparison to another vendor's product anywhere: not in BRAND.md, not in a copy deck, not in a commit message or PR. Write what holds, never why it changed. (2) The nexus-flow board (.nxs symlink) and .nxf/ must stay out of git; both are in .gitignore since 2026-08-08 — do not remove those entries.
